definitions.explanation: The eighth month of the year. The hottest month, featuring Obon (mid-August), a time to honor ancestors.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: I go to the sea in August.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦なので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: August is summer vacation, so many people travel.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実家|じっか}→実家：03076_jikka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Many people go back to their parents' home during Obon in August.

examples.japanese: {八月|はちがつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{暑|あつ}くて→暑い：00619_atsui⟧、⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦できません→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: August is hot every day, and you can't live without air conditioning.

notes:
{八月|はちがつ} is August - literally "month eight."

MONTH PATTERN:
Number + {月|がつ} = month name
- {八|はち} (8) + {月|がつ} = August

CULTURAL NOTE:
- ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧ (mid-August): Major holiday when people return to hometowns to honor ancestors
- ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧: Summer vacation period for schools
- ⟦{花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}→花火大会：10105_hanabitaikai⟧: Fireworks festivals are common
- Hottest month in Japan

COMPOUNDS:
- {八月|はちがつ}⟦{中旬|ちゅうじゅん}→中旬：11309_chuujun⟧: mid-August
- {八月|はちがつ}⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧: end of August
